title: The sandbox-start benchmark measures the copy the factory no longer ships
description:
Found by tick e08 (run epic-9pd, attempt 9).

e08 moved only the raw dated artifact its cold-start guard reads. The re-measurement harness (scripts/bench_sandbox_start.py) and docs/sandbox-start-benchmark.md are still in ticks, so re-running the benchmark measures ticks' copy of cloud/sandbox while the container the factory embeds is built from ticfac's.

Decide where re-measurement belongs now that the container ships from here, and move or repoint the harness and its doc. Depends on who ends up owning cloud/sandbox — do this after that decision, or it will be moved twice.
acceptance_criteria: Re-running the sandbox-start benchmark measures the image the factory actually ships, and the harness and its doc live with whoever owns that image
